process.title: Application
process.body: Fill in the form or message us on WhatsApp; our franchise team will get in touch.

process.title: First meeting
process.body: We walk you through the model. Shortlisted candidates are invited to our head office or the nearest branch, where we sign the agreement and choose the location together.

process.title: Design and build-out
process.body: A concept-compliant project and 3D design are prepared and budgeted. Construction is contracted out and supplies are ordered; costs are covered by the investor.

process.title: Training
process.body: Our operations team recruits your staff and delivers theory, then hands-on training. Travel and accommodation are covered by the investor.

process.title: Opening
process.body: Our operations team completes the final preparations and your store opens its doors.

franchising.title: Franchising — Terms, process and application
franchising.description: Coffee House franchise terms: no entry fee, no royalties, at least 40 m², turnkey cost of about USD 600–700 per m² + VAT. A five-step process, FAQs and the application form.
franchising.lead: We set up our takeaway coffee concept for you turnkey and keep supporting your business after opening. Terms, process and the application form are all on this page.
franchising.investLead: These terms are compiled from Coffee House's current publications; up-to-date figures are confirmed at the first meeting.

invest.note: Varies with the scope of construction and the condition of the premises.

invest.v: Busy areas with heavy foot traffic

faq.q: Do I pay a franchise entry fee?
faq.a: No. There is no entry fee in the Coffee House franchise model.

faq.q: Are there monthly royalties or a turnover share?
faq.a: No. We take no share of your monthly turnover; your earnings stay in your business.

faq.q: How much space does a store need?
faq.a: At least 40 m². Locations in busy areas with heavy foot traffic are preferred.

faq.q: How much does the turnkey set-up cost?
faq.a: On average USD 600–700 per m² + VAT, depending on the scope of construction and the condition of the premises. The budget is finalised at the design stage.
We choose it together after the first meeting; the architectural project is then designed for that location.
Our operations team recruits your staff and delivers theory, then hands-on training. Travel and accommodation during training are covered by the investor.
Yes. Abroad we work with master franchise and distribution models; we already have branches in Dubai and Kyrgyzstan.
Both brands share the same business model and supply platform. We decide together which one suits your region at the first meeting.

ch.slogan: The best beans, at the best Coffee House.
body: Coffee House pairs quality coffee with a fast, warm takeaway experience. Its blue speech-bubble logo, the neon sign that welcomes you to “the home of coffee” and its pop-art walls create the same familiar atmosphere in every branch.
The menu — from espresso drinks and iced coffee to frappés and desserts — is shared across all branches; each branch manages only its own prices and stock.
facts: Branches in Türkiye, the UAE and Kyrgyzstan

body: Coffee Art is the sister brand of the Coffee House family, growing with its Karaköprü and Piazza Mall branches in Şanlıurfa and its Ajman branch in the United Arab Emirates.
It shares Coffee House's supply and training platform; the right brand for your region is decided together at the first meeting.

about.title: About us — Coffee House
about.description: A takeaway coffee franchise sharing the know-how it has built since 2007 with investors.
about.lead: We share the know-how we have built since 2007 with investors who want to open their own coffee shop.
body: Coffee House turned the takeaway coffee concept into a standardised business model. We set up your store turnkey, from design to opening day, train your staff and keep supporting your business afterwards.

Favourable supply agreements and a model with no entry fee and no royalties aim for a franchise relationship in which both sides win. We continue our growth in Türkiye abroad through master franchise and distribution models.
